title: StudentOnboardingEvent
description: Canonical data contract for Habot Connect student onboarding pipeline.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the data contract.

student_name.description: Full legal name of the student.

parent_name.description: Full legal name of the parent or legal guardian.

email.description: Verified communication email address for the student or guardian.

consent.description: Mandatory parental/guardian consent flag. Must strictly be true.

support_required.description: Flag indicating whether specialized learning or technical support is requested.

learning_support_type.description: Category of learning support requested. If support_required is false, this must be NONE.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp recording when the record was validated and submitted.
